content:
Field
Description
AgentIdString
Falcon sensor ID.
ProcessId
Process ID of the process.
ComputerName
ComputerName/host on which the IOC was seen.
MD5String, SHA256String,
DomainName, IPv4, IPv6
The type of the IOC. The value for this field will be the value that you specified when you uploaded the IOC using the
Falcon APIs. For example, if you upload an IOC for a domain called "my-evil-domain.com," that would be the value.
ParentProcessId
The parent process ID of the IOC.
ProcessStartTime
A Unix timestamp of the start of the process.
FileName
Name of the file.
FilePath
Full path of the file, excluding the file name.
CommandLine
The command line execution of the process.
DeviceId
The agent ID of the host on which the IOC ran.
